findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：2025 年 7 月美歐聯合聲明中，歐盟承諾不採行或維持網路使用費；但歐盟及其他司法管轄區仍有事實上義務的風險；2025 年 1 月美國聯邦上訴法院推翻 FCC 網路中立規則，規則不確定性可能影響公司成長。
findings.excerpt: In July 2025, in an important joint statement with the United States, the EU committed not to adopt or maintain such network usage fees, although the risk of de facto obligations remains in the EU and in certain other jurisdictions.

findings.claim: DOJ 就 Netflix 收購 Warner Bros. 案發出民事調查要求，檢視 Clayton Act 第 7 條與 Sherman Act 第 2 條，並詢問 Netflix 對獨立製片與創作者的議價力。
findings.source: Bloomberg Law｜DOJ Probes Netflix's Power Over Filmmakers in Warner Deal Review
findings.excerpt: is seeking to determine whether the deal “may substantially lessen competition or tend to create a monopoly in violation of Section 7 of the Clayton Act or Section 2 of the Sherman Act,” according to a copy of a civil investigative demand reviewed by Bloomberg News that was sent Friday.

findings.claim: 倡議團體 Demand Progress 於 2026-07-07 發起「Netflix is a Monopoly」運動，要求 DOJ、FTC 調查（倡議，非官方行動）。
findings.source: MLex｜'Netflix is a Monopoly' campaign seeks US DOJ, FTC investigation
findings.excerpt: 'Netflix is a Monopoly' campaign seeks US DOJ, FTC investigation July 7, 2026, 5:39 PM GMT MLex Summary: Netflix's dominance of subscription video streaming merits an antitrust investigation, according to a campaign by advocacy group Demand Progress Education Fund that includes a "Netflix is a Monopoly" billboard...

note: 搜尋摘要顯示 DOJ 於 2026-02 就 Netflix 擬收購 Warner Bros. Discovery 的案件發出民事調查要求（Clayton Act 第 7 條＋Sherman Act 第 2 條）、歐盟議員去函歐盟執委會、2026-07-07 Demand Progress 發起「Netflix is a Monopoly」倡議；另有未註明日期的報導稱 Netflix 已撤回 WBD 競標，交易現況未能確認。搜尋結果未顯示針對 Netflix 本身的正式 DOJ／FTC／歐盟執法行動。德州隱私訴訟僅見低品質來源，未採信。以上均只有搜尋摘要、未讀頁面，列為 clues。 線索 2 條，程式核實 2 條
